themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Multiple far-right leaders across Europe and the Americas are confronting legal battles, political scandals, and internal party strife. These challenges are reshaping their public image and electoral strategies, with some leaders like Marine Le Pen and Javier Milei continuing their campaigns despite convictions or controversies.
